subtitle.zh: 36 趟出行、63 天、16 夜，孩子同去了 24 趟——把这一年最值得记的几次挑出来讲讲。
subtitle.en: 36 trips, 63 days and 16 nights outdoors, 24 of them with the kids: the highlights of the year.

translator.note: 个人随笔（年度回顾），按原文的自然语气译。人名、地名、山峰名、机构名保留英文：`Nacho`、`Cristina`、`Maia`、`Round Top`、`Winnemucca Lake`、`Mt Hood`、`MAA`（Mountain Ascent Association 的缩写）、`Redwood National Parks`、`Crater Lake`、`Smith Rock`、`Portland`、`Illumination Saddle`、`Palmer`、`Enchanted Pools`、`Desolation Wilderness`、`Twin Lakes`、`The Yuba`、`Nevada City`、`Lake Tahoe`、`Echo Peaks`、`Tuolumne Meadows`、`Unicorn Peak`、`Cathedral Lake`、`Joshua Tree`、`Pinnacles National Park`、`High Peaks`、`Bear Gulch`、`Sequoia National Park`、`The Needles`、`Castle Peak`、`Pyramid Peak`、`Tenaya`、`Grand Canyon`、`Tetons`、`Mt Moran`、`Teewinot`、`Yellowstone`。源文小标题在归档里是 `####`，译文按 schema 统一为 `h2`。图库里的图片在源文里是缩进很深的 `![图](缩略图)` 行、彼此之间用空行隔开，译文按全站图片口径归一化为一个个图片块（丢掉外层链接与缩略图后缀、保留原图 URL），与源文逐行对应；`OLYMPUS DIGITAL CAMERA` 是相机自动写入的说明，按原样保留为独立段落；源文自己给出的照片说明行（`At the top of one of the Echo Peaks`、`Campsite near Cathedral Lake`、`Sequoia Natl Park`、`The Needles Lookout`）也在原位置保留为独立段落。保真核验按文件主名比对图片，这些文件名在译文 `en` 里原样保留。

blocks.en: One of my goals for this year is to write more about our trips and adventures. I’ve been thinking I could write a guide book with all the material that I have, but in order to do that I would have to get better at documenting and organizing it. To get started I’m going to do a quick overview of the trips we did last year.
blocks.zh: 我今年的目标之一是多写点我们的出行和冒险。我一直在想，凭手上这些材料我都可以写本向导书了，但要真写，我得先把记录和整理这件事做好。作为开头，我先快速回顾一下去年走过的行程。

blocks.en: I thought 2018 was a slow year compared to the previous ones, but now that I sit down and look at everything we have done, I think it’s probably about average. I went on a total of 36 trips, totaling 63 days and 16 nights outdoors. The kids joined me on 24 of those trips (for 41 days and 10 nights). Initially I was thinking I could write a summary about each one, but that would be a very long post! Instead I’m just going to highlight the ones that I enjoyed the most.
blocks.zh: 我原以为 2018 年比前几年清闲，可坐下来把做过的事过一遍，我觉得大概也就是平均水平。我一共出行 36 趟，合计 63 天、16 夜在户外。孩子们跟我去了其中 24 趟（41 天、10 夜）。一开始我想给每一趟都写个小结，那这帖子就太长了！所以我只挑自己最喜欢的几次来讲。

blocks.en: None of the trips were particularly challenging. The year was punctuated by several injuries and I’ve been feeling out of shape and more tired than usual. I don’t know if this is a sign of me getting old, or just that I need to slow down and give myself more time to recover. The kids are also growing up, it’s getting easier to take them along, and they both enjoy hiking and climbing, so I’ve been exploring with them more instead of going on personal trips.
blocks.zh: 这些行程都算不上特别有挑战。这一年里断断续续受了几次伤，我一直觉得状态不好，也比平时更累。我不知道这是不是变老的信号，还是只是我需要放慢节奏、给自己更多恢复时间。孩子们也在长大，带他们出门越来越容易，而且他们两个都喜欢徒步和攀登，所以我把更多时间花在跟他们一起探索上，而不是自己去跑个人行程。

blocks.en: Nacho and I try to do two major ascents every year, one in Winter and another in Summer. Last year we tried to climb Round Top, but we didn’t make it. The wind on the ridge was so strong that we could barely stand up and we had to turn around. This time however, the weather was perfect and we made it all the way to the summit. While last year we camped by Winnemucca Lake and tried to summit in the morning, this time we drove up before dawn, arrived at sunrise, and climbed it in a day. Car to car, it took us around 8 hours, a pretty long day for an 11-year-old!
blocks.zh: Nacho 和我每年尽量做两次大的攀登，一次冬天，一次夏天。去年我们试过爬 Round Top，没成功。山脊上的风大到我们几乎站不住，只能折返。这次天气却好得没话说，我们一路登上了山顶。去年我们是在 Winnemucca Lake 边扎营、第二天早上尝试登顶；这次我们天亮前就开车出发，日出时到达，一天之内爬完。从车到车大约花了 8 个小时，对一个 11 岁的孩子来说是很长的一天！

blocks.en: One of the most exciting events of the year was our Spring break trip. I had committed to climb Mt Hood with [MAA](http://mountainascent.org) and had to drive up there anyway, so I made a family vacation out of it and went with Cristina and the kids.  We spent a few days driving north, stopping by the Redwood National Parks, Crater Lake, Smith Rock; camping and hiking along the way, until we arrived to Portland. We rested there a couple of days and then Cristina flew back with the kids, while I stayed behind and tried my luck on an early season ascent of Mt Hood.
blocks.zh: 这一年最令人兴奋的事情之一是我们的春假旅行。我答应了跟 [MAA](http://mountainascent.org) 去爬 Mt Hood，反正也要开车过去，就把它变成了一次家庭度假，和 Cristina 还有孩子们一起走。我们花几天时间往北开，途中在 Redwood National Parks、Crater Lake、Smith Rock 停留，一路露营、徒步，直到抵达 Portland。在那里休息了两天，然后 Cristina 带着孩子飞回去，我留下来碰碰运气，试试季初登 Mt Hood。

blocks.en: The plan was to camp at Illumination Saddle the first day and then attempt to reach the summit on the next. We had a promising start, but as we ascended the weather worsened, and a whiteout set over the mountain. We did not only have strong winds and zero visibility, but the mist was getting everyone wet. Most of us were not ready for such humid conditions and we had to setup an emergency camp next to the Palmer lift.
blocks.zh: 计划是第一天在 Illumination Saddle 扎营，第二天尝试登顶。开局很有希望，但往上走天气越来越糟，山上起了白化天气。我们不仅遇上大风、能见度为零，雾气还把每个人都打湿了。我们大多数人没为这种潮湿环境做准备，只好在 Palmer 缆车旁搭了个应急营地。

blocks.en: I had a terrible night. My wet clothes were soaking my down bag. I could not get my body to warm up, let alone catch any sleep. Morale was low and everyone expected to get back down the next morning. However, when I got out of the tent at 3 AM the sky was clear and the wind was gone! Excited I woke everyone up, headed up with 6 other climbers, and made it to the summit.
blocks.zh: 那一夜糟透了。湿衣服把我的羽绒睡袋也浸湿了。我完全暖不起来，更别说睡着了。士气很低，所有人都觉得第二天早上就得下撤。可当我凌晨 3 点钻出帐篷时，天是晴的，风也停了！我兴奋地把大家叫醒，和另外 6 名登山者一起往上走，登上了山顶。

blocks.en: This was the kids’ favorite trip of 2018 and is certainly one of our greatest discoveries. The Enchanted Pools are a series of swimming holes, shallow pools, cascades, and water slides along the drainage of Twin Lakes in Desolation Wilderness. To get there you have to hike out of trail and occasionally wade, swim, and scramble. You also have to time it right: Too early and the water will be freezing and the currents too strong. Too late and the creek will be dry and you will only find pools of stagnant water. On July 1st of 2018 conditions were perfect. I’d like to write more about this some day, but for now I’ll just tease you with a couple of pictures.
blocks.zh: 这是孩子们 2018 年最喜欢的一趟，也肯定是我们最大的发现之一。Enchanted Pools 是 Desolation Wilderness 里 Twin Lakes 水系沿线的一串水潭、浅池、跌水和小滑水道。要去那里得离开步道，偶尔还要涉水、游泳、攀爬。时机也很讲究：去得太早，水冰冷、水流太急；去得太晚，溪就干了，只剩一潭潭死水。2018 年 7 月 1 日，条件完美。以后我想专门写写这里，现在先用两张照片吊吊你的胃口。
在 The Yuba 办婚礼

blocks.en: I’m lucky to have a wife that tolerates (and sometimes enjoys) my adventures. We got married in 2017, but this summer we invited our family and friends to celebrate with us doing what we both enjoy the most: playing outdoors and soaking in water.
blocks.zh: 我很幸运，有个能容忍（有时还挺享受）我这些冒险的妻子。我们在 2017 年就结婚了，但这个夏天我们请了家人和朋友来一起庆祝，做我们俩最喜欢的事：在户外玩，泡在水里。

blocks.en: It was amazing to have so many of our family and friends join us and to share with them some of the places we love. I don’t really like how weddings are celebrated in the US and we wanted to do something more intimate and personal, and a little more adventurous. I’m really happy with how things turned out!
blocks.zh: 能有这么多家人朋友来参加，还能跟他们分享一些我们喜欢的地方，感觉太好了。我不太喜欢美国办婚礼的那套方式，我们想做点更私密、更个人化，也更有冒险味道的。结果让我非常满意！

blocks.en: We rented a large vacation house near Nevada City, camped around the property, went on excursions to Lake Tahoe, the Yuba and its surroundings, and had a lovely ceremony by the river. We didn’t hire any wedding or catering service, but instead did everything on our own, it was a team effort. Our only regret is not hiring a photographer to capture it in more detail.
blocks.zh: 我们在 Nevada City 附近租了一栋大度假屋，在房子周围搭帐篷露营，去 Lake Tahoe、The Yuba 和周边转了几趟，在河边办了一场很美的仪式。我们没请婚庆或餐饮服务，所有事都自己动手，是大家一起干出来的。唯一的遗憾是没请摄影师，把它记录得更细一些。

blocks.en: Echo Peaks – End of the Summer

I was lucky to get backpacking permits in Tuolumne Meadows for the last weekend before the school starts, I had to reserve these 6 months in advance! The year before Nacho and I had a blast climbing Unicorn Peak and we had set our eyes on Echo Peak, a taller peak on the same ridge composed of multiple class 4 summits. Our goal was to climb as many of them as we could. To save weight I didn’t carry a rope, but seeing him solo that terrain was a bit unnerving. He didn’t think it was big deal (and it probably wasn’t), but I was freaking out a little.
blocks.zh: 运气不错，我拿到了 Tuolumne Meadows 开学前最后一个周末的背包许可，得提前 6 个月预订！前一年 Nacho 和我爬 Unicorn Peak 爬得很过瘾，之后我们就盯上了 Echo Peak——同一条山脊上更高的一座，由好几个四级难度的峰顶组成。我们的目标是尽量多爬几个。为了减轻重量我没带绳，可看着他一个人过那种地形还是有点让人心里发毛。他觉得没什么大不了（大概确实没什么），但我有点慌。

blocks.en: At the top of one of the Echo Peaks
blocks.zh: 在其中一个 Echo Peaks 的顶上

blocks.en: We have been going to Joshua Tree every Fall for the last few years, but this trip was special for two reasons. First, Maia is becoming a confident climber and I was excited to have her practice her new skills outdoors. Second, I rented a [pretty cool camper van](https://www.outervan.com/) and we got to experience the “van” life for a few days.
blocks.zh: 过去几年我们每年秋天都去 Joshua Tree，但这一趟有两个特别之处。第一，Maia 正在成为一个有自信的攀登者，我很期待让她在户外练练新学的本事。第二，我租了一辆[挺酷的露营车](https://www.outervan.com/)，我们体验了几天「房车」生活。

blocks.en: Days are short in the Fall and I try to spend them outdoors, which means that I do most of the driving during the night. The hardest part of these trips is getting to our destination, cooking dinner and setting up camp in the cold dark with the kids half asleep. In this respect the van made things a lot easier. The bed was super comfortable; we still had to sleep in our sleeping bags, but the luxurious memory foam mattress made a big difference. On the other side, I feel like it disconnects you from the place and detracts from some of the adventure. While in the past the kids would get out and start scrambling and exploring as soon as the sun came out, in the van it was much harder to get things moving in the morning, and I have no stories to share about waking up in the middle of a sand storm to anchor the tent to avoid flying away. All in all, I think it was a positive experience, and I’m already dreaming about the day I get to afford to have my own van.
blocks.zh: 秋天白昼短，我尽量把白天都花在户外，所以大部分路都是夜里开的。这类行程最难的部分，是在又冷又黑的时候抵达目的地、做晚饭、扎营，而孩子们已经半睡半醒。这方面露营车让事情轻松多了。床超级舒服；我们还是得睡睡袋，但那块奢侈的记忆棉床垫差别很大。反过来说，我觉得它把你和这个地方隔开了，也削减了一部分冒险感。以前太阳一出来孩子们就会跑出去攀爬、探索，而在露营车里，早上要把大家弄动起来难得多，我也再没有「半夜沙暴里醒来给帐篷打地钉免得被吹走」这种故事可讲了。总的来说，我觉得这是一次不错的体验，我已经在梦想哪天能买得起自己的露营车了。

blocks.en: The trip itself was great. On the way there we spent a day at Pinnacles National Park, hiked the High Peaks trail, explored the Bear Gulch cave system, and were lucky to see some condors from really close. In Joshua Tree we revisited some of our favorite locations and explored some new climbing areas, and on the way back we stopped by some of the Redwood Groves in Sequoia National park and hiked to the fire lookout on top of The Needles.
blocks.zh: 行程本身很棒。去程我们在 Pinnacles National Park 待了一天，走了 High Peaks 步道，探了 Bear Gulch 的洞穴系统，还很幸运地在很近的地方看到了几只神鹫。在 Joshua Tree，我们重访了几个最喜欢的地方，也探索了一些新的攀爬区域；回程时在 Sequoia National Park 的几片红杉林停留，还徒步去了 The Needles 顶上的防火瞭望台。

blocks.en: I’ve decided I’m going to stop leading trips for [MAA](http://mountainascent.org/). I’m enormously grateful for the opportunities the club has given me, the friendships I’ve made, and everything I’ve learned from them. However, organizing and leading trips is stressful, distracting, and time consuming. While I’m not going to stop climbing, I’m going to focus on doing that with my friends and my family.
blocks.zh: 我决定不再为 [MAA](http://mountainascent.org/) 带队了。我非常感激这个俱乐部给我的机会、我在这里交到的朋友，以及从他们身上学到的一切。但组织和带队压力大、分心、又费时间。我不会停止攀登，只是要把重心放在和朋友、家人一起爬。

blocks.en: I think Maia is ready for her first winter ascent, I’m planning to take her to Castle Peak in a few weeks. Nacho should be able to climb Pyramid Peak this Winter, and maybe Tenaya this Summer. For Spring break I’d like to do a family trip to the Grand Canyon. As for me I also need goals to keep training and stay motivated. I’d like to get back to the Tetons, climb Mt Moran, Teewinot, and revisit the Grand through a different route. It would also be great to do some backpacking over there with the kids and take them to Yellowstone. Closer to home in California I have such a large ‘to do’ list that it would require another post!
blocks.zh: 我觉得 Maia 已经可以为她的第一次冬季攀登做准备了，我打算过几周带她去 Castle Peak。Nacho 这个冬天应该能爬 Pyramid Peak，夏天也许能去 Tenaya。春假我想安排一次去 Grand Canyon 的家庭旅行。对我自己来说，也需要目标才能坚持训练、保持动力。我想再回 Tetons，爬 Mt Moran、Teewinot，再换一条路线重访 Grand。能带孩子们去那边背包徒步、带他们去 Yellowstone 也很好。至于加州这边离家近的地方，我的「待办清单」长得可以再写一篇帖子！
